label: Second copy step (output orig token 1), content-gated by t/2/k/q/w/o/p-like tokens
explanation: Fires almost exclusively (99.9% of mass) at the step right after <DEL> (t = L+1, input = orig(0), outputting orig(1)); recall_idx==1 alone has recall 0.998 but precision 0.22. Within that position it fires on ~22% of sequences: rate peaks at L=5-7 (rare at L=4 and 9, never L=3), and is boosted when the outputs orig(1)/orig(2) are tokens like t, 2, k (about 4-5x lift), then q, w, o, p, y, g; a last original token of w or q also raises it. Top activations are sequences like m 2 t k k q w <DEL> m. Does not fire in the original phase, at the delimiter, or at any later copy step. The content dependence is diffuse across many tokens, so precision stays around 0.5 and F1 plateaus near 0.58.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the next token to output (most: t, 2, k, q, w, p; least: n, 0, x, f) and the token being output (most: t, k, 2, y, o, q; least: d, b, 0, f); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=1, L=6 & t=7, t=7.
